appDescription.message: Play chess against Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Perplexity and Copilot from the side panel. No backend, 100% local.

connections_choosePin.message: Choose and pin one supported AI tab before sending a prompt.

connections_noTabs.message: No supported AI tabs open. Open one below, then refresh.

connections_pinLost.message: The pinned AI tab closed or left a supported host. Choose another tab; no prompt was sent.

connections_pinFailed.message: That tab could not be pinned. Open a supported AI chat and try again.

connections_unpinned.message: AI tab unpinned. Choose a tab before the next prompt.

controls_confirmSide.message: Start a NEW game as the other side? The current game will end.

controls_switchSideTitle.message: Start a new game as the other side

status_sideNewGame.message: You now play {color}. A new game has started.

status_paused.message: Companion paused. No prompts or observers are active.

status_resumed.message: Companion resumed. Ask the AI again when a reply is expected.

status_waitGeneration.message: Waiting for {platform} to finish generating… Do not press Enter.

status_manualSend.message: Copy the prompt, paste and send it yourself in the pinned AI tab. The reply will be watched.

status_manualCopied.message: Prompt copied. Paste and send it yourself in the pinned AI tab; waiting for your message.

status_generationTimeout.message: The model is still generating. No prompt was sent; copy it to send later.

status_verifyFailed.message: The full prompt was not in the composer. Nothing was sent. Copy it instead.

status_illegalReason.message: The AI answered [{move}]: {reason} Ask again to correct it.

status_aiResigned.message: The AI resigned. Start a new game to play again.

status_sendFailure.message: Could not send the prompt: {detail} Copy it instead.

match_stockfishNotice.message: Strength-limited Stockfish is GPL-3, runs locally, no network. Stockfish UCI_Elo scale, not FIDE.

match_paused.message: Stockfish stopped while paused. Resume to reload it.

match_noGames.message: No rated games yet. Complete a real game against the pinned chat AI.

match_requiresAuto.message: Rated matches require Auto send mode. Change it in AI settings.

match_requiresPin.message: Rated matches require one live pinned AI chat tab.

match_confirmReplace.message: Start a rated Stockfish match? This starts a NEW game and replaces the current board.

match_started.message: Rated game started. Chat AI plays {color}; Stockfish anchor {anchor}.

match_engineThinking.message: Stockfish is choosing a move at UCI_Elo {anchor}…

match_unratedProtocol.message: Protocol failed: game unfinished / unrated. No engine move replaced the AI.

match_pinLost.message: Pinned tab lost: match unfinished / unrated. Pin another chat to play.

match_storageError.message: Could not store the rated game. No estimate was updated.

match_finished.message: Rated game finished: {result}. See the estimate in Analysis.

match_running.message: Stop the rated match before loading a different game.

analysis_confirmEngine.message: Start a NEW local game against the heuristic engine? This replaces the current board.

analysis_engineMode.message: Local engine game started (strength 1–8, no Elo).

analysis_engineFailed.message: The local engine could not make a move.

illegal_opponent_piece.message: The piece on {from} belongs to the other side.

illegal_does_not_move_that_way.message: That piece cannot move from {from} to {to}.

illegal_leaves_king_in_check.message: That move would leave the king in check.

illegal_castle_rights.message: Castling rights or the required rook are missing.

illegal_castle_through_check.message: The king cannot castle out of, through, or into check.

illegal_en_passant_illegal.message: There is no legal en passant capture on that square.

illegal_promotion_required.message: A pawn reaching the last rank needs a promotion suffix (q, r, b or n).

illegal_promotion_illegal.message: Promotion is only allowed on a pawn move to the last rank.

illegal_not_in_legal_set.message: That move is not in the legal set for this position.

badge_pin.message: AI Chess Companion — pin an AI chat tab to play

badge_check.message: AI Chess Companion — {color} is in check

badge_white.message: AI Chess Companion — White to move

badge_black.message: AI Chess Companion — Black to move

status_timeoutCopied.message: The AI is still generating. The prompt was copied; nothing was sent.

status_awaitingUnpinned.message: It is {color}’s turn, but no AI chat is pinned. Pin one supported tab to continue.

outcome_insufficientMaterial.message: Draw — not enough material to mate. {result}

illegal_repeated_move.message: That move was already rejected in this position; choose a different legal move.
